newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rwanda's Kagame to visit South Africa.
newsitem.headline: Rwanda's Kagame to visit South Africa.

text.p: Rwandan Vice President Paul Kagame will visit South Africa from Wednesday, the foreign ministry in Pretoria said on the eve of the three-day visit.

"The South African government views this visit within the framework of its commitment to contributing to international efforts to bringing about lasting peace and stability in central Africa," its statement said.

The powerful Kagame, also Rwanda's defence minister, came to office after he and fellow ethnic Tutsis drove out the previous Hutu-led regime, whose followers took part in the 1994 genocide of up to one million Tutsis.
